args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export skipping the first week when created on the same day
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In `nextRunAt`, the weekly case unconditionally advances by 7 days without checking whether `next <= from`, unlike the daily case. When a weekly schedule is created before the run hour on the same day, `next` is already in the future relative to `from`, but adding 7 days skips the current week's run. Fix this by adding the same `if (next <= from) next.setUTCDate(next.getUTCDate() + 7);` logic (or advancing by 7 days only when `next <= from`) so a newly created schedule runs on its starting day if created before the scheduled hour.
